mapper.sql: FROM cm_creator_account ca INNER JOIN cm_monitor_target mt ON mt.creator_id = ca.creator_id AND mt.target_type = 'creator_collection' AND mt.status = 'active' AND mt.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT ca.*, COALESCE(NULLIF(su.nick_name, ''), su.user_name) AS added_by_name, mt.contact_wechat AS contact_wechat FROM cm_creator_account ca INNER JOIN cm_monitor_target mt ON mt.creator_id = ca.creator_id AND mt.status = 'active' AND mt.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = mt.owner_user_id WHERE ca.creator_id = #{creatorId} AND ca.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY mt.update_time DESC LIMIT 1
